views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
views.zh: 效率是核心：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

views.en: Attention remains crucial at scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate under Scaling（规模扩张）.
views.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；在 Scaling（规模扩张）下无偏架构占优。

views.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline intelligence; open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty.
views.zh: 端侧小型语言模型提供私密、离线的智能；开放权重模型让企业可定制并掌控数据主权。

views.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety.
views.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非安全。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but compute-expensive and early; current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of human brains, so new paradigms—not just architectures—are needed.
views.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在但算力昂贵且尚早；当前 AI 缺乏人脑多样的学习算法，需要新范式而非仅新架构。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展主要由可验证性与“可磨性”（并行 rollout）驱动，而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已足够。

views.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; generating interesting conjectures is the next benchmark.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释，提出有趣猜想成为下一个基准。

views.en: AI is a net win for creators only when used selectively, never for core creative work; AI-generated content damages handcrafted brand.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调，AI 只有在选择性使用时才对创作者是净收益，绝不用于核心创作；AI 生成内容会损害手工内容的品牌。

views.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

views.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding and human framing still matter for learning.
views.zh: 2026 年他承认数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解与人类框架对学习仍然重要。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准是客户成果，而非停留时长。

views.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep them in control.
views.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此应让其保持掌控。

views.en: Competing with model labs isn't hard since they can't capture all customers; founders should focus, not fear frontier labs.
views.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难，因为它们无法俘获所有客户；创始人应专注，而非畏惧前沿模型。

views.en: Deep understanding of code stays crucial; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it, leaving room for improvement.
views.zh: 对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；AI 编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解，仍有改进空间。

views.en: Solving software creation by 2026 creates a thousand times more opportunity, not less; the delta between engineering, product and research blurs.
views.zh: 到 2026 年软件创造被基本解决，会带来千倍机会而非减少；工程、产品与研究的界限正变模糊。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而不只是靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此单纯靠算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）并非唯一路径。

views.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale—so neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement.
views.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 1000 万规模，词元越多准确率越低——因此权重中的神经记忆痕迹是必要补充。

views.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge via parameter-efficient fine-tuning, beating RAG for holistic queries.
views.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应借参数高效微调用于企业知识，在整体性查询上胜过检索增强。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models: continual learning runs on-device, with users owning and nurturing their weights.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型：持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth bottlenecks long-context inference more than compute.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点从训练转向推理经济：批大小是延迟与成本之间的主要杠杆，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

views.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but with quality limits.
views.zh: 他明确指出上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存开销，但有质量代价。

views.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifecycle.
views.zh: 他认为模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为决定生命周期成本的是推理而非训练。

views.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that overhead deterministically.
views.zh: 他把数据搬运视为比计算更根本的成本，芯片内的脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为确定性降低这一开销。

views.en: Low precision pays off more than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 up to 3x FP8, reshaping frontier model economics.
views.zh: 他深化了对低精度的判断：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的三倍，从而重塑前沿模型的经济性。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, xAI (Grok Imagine); ex-NVIDIA (Cosmos)
people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.tiEn: Researcher, Google; PhD student, Cornell (continual learning)
people.tiZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔博士生（持续学习）
people.bioEn: Researcher at Google and PhD student at Cornell, working on continual learning and new sequence-model architectures (Nested Learning, Titans).
people.bioZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔大学博士生，研究持续学习与新型序列模型架构（Nested Learning、Titans）。

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.tiZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员
people.bioEn: Founding researcher at Sakana AI, working at the intersection of large language models and evolutionary methods (e.g. Shinka Evolve).
people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Can AI Infrastructure Keep Growing Exponentially?
Which GPU Clouds Are Actually Good? ClusterMAX 3.0
AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Scaling's binding constraint is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV, not capital or demand; compute stays scarce and valuable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的硬约束在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV，而非资本或需求；算力持续稀缺且保值。

views.en: Inference becomes a top global market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth, not raw bits, drive multiplicative gains.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把推理视为全球最大市场之一，强调软硬件协同设计与内存带宽而非位密度带来乘数级收益。

views.en: Agentic workflows and reinforcement learning lift memory and CPU demand; persistent agents as coworkers define the next adoption wave.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 至 8 月，智能体式工作流与强化学习推高内存和 CPU 需求；作为同事的持久智能体成为下一波采用主线。

views.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, cutting inference share, enabling self-funded growth.
views.zh: 2026 年 8 月，算力向前沿实验室集中；实验室把算力转向训练与研发、压缩推理占比，实现自我供血式增长。

views.en: Capex near 5-6% of US GDP must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; value shifts from hardware to labs.
views.zh: 2026 年 10 月，AI 资本开支已近美国 GDP 的 5-6%，将因资本与组织约束而减速；价值从硬件转向实验室。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust judgment, assume ideas are wrong 75% of the time, and start embarrassingly small.
views.zh: 直觉胜过点子：相信判断力，默认点子有 75%概率是错的，并从不起眼的小处起步。

views.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and expect all-new ideas to fail.
views.zh: “已验证、更优、全新”框架：复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并预设全新想法会失败。

views.en: Distribution is fundamental and must be designed into the product from day one, not added later.
views.zh: 分发是根本，必须从第一天就设计进产品，而不是事后补上。

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may arrive around 2029.
views.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下“不可投”，却是最大的机会；真正的革命可能要到 2029 年前后。

views.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
views.zh: AI 有变革性但尚非新平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费级服务。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should pursue wacky new algorithms and architectures.
views.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应去追古怪的新算法与新架构。

views.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years on it versus 500,000 on language, making spatial intelligence the next frontier beyond language.
views.zh: 视觉被低估：自然为视觉花了 5.4 亿年、语言只花 50 万年，因此空间智能是语言智能之后的下一个前沿。

views.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
views.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式而非因果理论，或许永远推不出牛顿定律；像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; unified systems will combine all three.
views.zh: 世界模型是语言模型之后的下一个前沿，涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器；未来统一系统将三者合一。

views.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; world models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem.
views.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法获得世界理解；世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成了日常难题。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking time; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年：推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将其外化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的实用性。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited. Continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年：Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化和自我纠错仍有限。持续学习是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

views.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling, is the key bottleneck. RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
views.zh: 2026 年：Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上受限；架构而非仅 Scaling（规模扩张）是关键瓶颈。强化学习不是从经验中学习的唯一方式。

views.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; small teams with capable agents will drive frontier research. Transformer is unlikely optimal; alignment is unsolved.
views.zh: 2026 年：人类研究者至少还需存在两年；小型团队借助强大智能体将推动前沿研究。Transformer 不太可能是最优架构；对齐问题尚未解决。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: Why AlphaFold Didn't Solve Protein Folding: Data, Scaling, and the Future of Bioscience
From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜，而非窄应用；并用硬性评测指标逼模型泛化而非记忆。

views.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and post-training RL show AI can exceed human data in verifiable domains like code.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初，他借 AlphaGo 复盘指出：直觉加搜索、以及后训练中的强化学习，能让 AI 在代码等可验证领域超越人类数据。

views.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust, and scalable, embedded in regulation and even protein design.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向水印：好水印须不可感知、抗攻击、可跨模态扩展，并已进入监管，甚至延伸到蛋白质序列与结构。

views.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where compute and data help, and curate data coverage over volume.
views.zh: 2026 年 10 月他修正了 Scaling（规模扩张）信仰：缩放定律并非处处成立，关键是找到算力与数据起作用的区间，数据覆盖比体量更重要。

views.en: Define the problem first and stay flexible across modeling, data, and compute rather than committing to one dogma.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是先定义问题，在建模、数据与算力之间保持灵活，而不拘泥于单一信条。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: Reflection AI's Ioannis on Open-Weight Models and the Future of AI Agents
From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

views.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL enables self-generated data beyond human limits; LLMs lack their AlphaZero moment, maybe in 5 years.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键；强化学习让模型通过自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需 5 年。

views.en: Deployment of intelligence, not intelligence itself, is the bottleneck; open-weight models are safer; enterprises want AI sovereignty; cost per task matters.
views.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身成为瓶颈；开放权重模型更安全；企业需要 AI 主权；按任务成本而非按 token 成本衡量效率。

views.en: From scaling/planning focus to deployment bottleneck; still sees in-context learning as learning, no weight updates needed; digital AGI before embodied AGI.
views.zh: 从关注 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划转向部署瓶颈；始终认为上下文窗口内的学习即学习，无需权重更新；数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将早于具身 AGI 到来。

views.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment necessary because perfect sandboxes impossible; AI adoption takes 10-20 years.
views.zh: 不需要超级智能；客户只想要可靠的常规智能；对齐是必要的，因为完美的沙盒不可能；AI 普及将耗时 10-20 年。

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编写的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

views.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic novelty.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调：要 Scaling 出可泛化的 AI 司机，需要海量数据、算力与用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

views.en: Language integration deepens: it improves representation, reasoning, personalization and human interaction, and aids introspection in driving models.
views.zh: 语言集成不断深化：它提升驾驶模型的表征、推理、个性化与人机交互，并有助于模型的自我审视。

views.en: Deployment shifts to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors over expensive retrofits; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis short and medium term.
views.zh: 部署路线转向带内置传感器的大众车型，而非昂贵改装；他判断中短期内消费车辆将比 Robotaxi 更快放量。

views.en: Safety is paramount: minimal-risk maneuvers always offer a third option, so the trolley problem is theoretical; end-to-end was once mocked but now wins.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把安全置于首位：最小风险操作总能提供第三种选择，因此电车难题只是理论演练；端到端曾遭嘲笑，如今却成为胜出的路线。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
views.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利切入：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低，而未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学到东西，从而塑造人机关系。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; models need guidance for their novel existence, not just human analogies.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡，模型需要的是对其全新存在方式的引导，而非简单套用人类心理学类比。

views.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it a unique, childlike quality.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化了对模型人格的理解：Claude 的性格由训练数据和微调塑造，却缺乏真实世界经验，因而是一种带有孩童般特质的独特存在。

views.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确宪法式方法更接近德性伦理而非规则或后果论，重在塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少，判断空间应扩大。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识：过度顺从可能泛化不佳并削弱模型的判断力，同时公开 AI 价值观与训练目标对问责至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学；通过强化学习与合成数据实现的后训练 Scaling（规模扩张），可以突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此要用评估来定义正确行为。

views.en: Soft skills like creativity and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; prototyping replaces specs.
views.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值，产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

views.en: Post-training remains subjective human judgment; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化了“艺术而非科学”的判断：后训练仍依赖人的主观判断，需要多样且持续的基准来评估创造力与情商。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; more companies should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
views.zh: 2026 年，她警告前沿模型的智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，基准必须持续演进；并主张更多公司训练自己的模型，以保留独特知识与多元声音。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth still means owning equity, but by 2025 he frames AI as huge opportunity, not just safety risk.
views.zh: 从 2020 年强调财富源于持有股权，到 2025 年他把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，主张美国领先、轻监管、开源防权力集中。

views.en: Happiness is satisfaction with what you have; success comes from dissatisfaction; the journey is what matters.
views.zh: 2025 年他系统区分幸福与成功：幸福是对已有的满足，成功源于不满足，而真正重要的只有过程本身。

views.en: AI is a leverage layer for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps in English.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI 作为新的抽象层：氛围编程让非程序员用英语造应用，AI 放大判断力而非取代人类判断。

views.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; worry about unaligned humans, not unaligned AI.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步反转早期立场：超级智能已存在于计算器等窄工具中，真正的风险是未对齐的人类而非未对齐的 AI。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

views.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage: documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 PRD 未死，媒介须匹配阶段：文档求清晰，原型做测试。

views.en: Models increase code complexity; we need models better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolith.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型反而增加代码复杂度，需要更擅长删代码的模型；最好的桌面应用是连接工具的家园，而非单体超级应用。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need embodied experience, not just more pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年：具身对为 AI 提供现实基础、减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 需要具身经验，而不仅仅是更多预训练数据。

views.en: Reinforcement learning should be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with LLMs handling high-level planning.
views.zh: 2023 年：强化学习应是锦上添花；无监督学习承担大部分工作，LLM 负责高层规划。

views.en: Simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular approaches; research taste for simplicity is crucial.
views.zh: 2023→26 年：简单、优雅的端到端方案比复杂的模块化方法更具可扩展性；对简洁性的研究品味至关重要。

views.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 2026 年：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；来自模拟和世界模型的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: The GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away; intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040, but home use will take longer.
views.zh: 2026 年：机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约在五年后到来；到 2040 年智能机器人数量将超过 iPhone，但家庭使用还需更长时间。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data beating specialists.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把前沿从语言模型推向物理智能体：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，测试时推理与汇聚多实验室数据能让通才模型胜过专家模型。

views.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, so scale the right thing with diverse data.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确：机器人还没有 LLM 那样可预测的缩放定律曲线，核心挑战是泛化而非演示效果，因此要用多样化数据去 Scaling（规模扩张）正确的东西。

views.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key; robot foundation models trained on real embodied data absorb human video better than the reverse.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调部署机器人形成的数据飞轮：先用真实具身数据训练机器人基础模型，再吸收人类视频，顺序不能反过来。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识的安全观：机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识而非约束，规模化下触觉传感可能与视觉冗余。

views.en: Home robots need milestones like autonomous improvement and transferring common sense; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
views.zh: 2026 年他展望家用机器人：需实现自主改进与常识迁移等里程碑，未来是日常物体普遍具备物理驱动，而非机械人形。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: David Silver & Lasse Espeholt on Building a Superlearner for the Age of Experience
From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

views.en: Human data is finite like fossil fuels; AI must move to learning from its own experience to reach superintelligence.
views.zh: 人类数据像化石燃料一样有限；AI 必须转向从自身经验中学习，才能走向超级智能。

views.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they distill human knowledge and cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data.
views.zh: 大语言模型是浅层方案：它们蒸馏人类知识，无法发现超出人类数据的新知识。

views.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance in narrow domains.
views.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明，从经验中学习能在狭窄领域取得超人表现。

views.en: The core problem is building an agent that can learn from any reward, not designing the reward function.
views.zh: 核心问题在于构建能从任意奖励中学习的智能体，而非设计奖励函数。

views.en: Superintelligence can be built entirely in simulation; human language and human-in-the-loop are reaching their limits.
views.zh: 超级智能可以完全在模拟中构建；人类语言与人类在环的方式正接近极限。

views.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning with adjustments; a small team with high compute per person can outperform larger organizations.
views.zh: 缩放定律经调整后适用于强化学习；人均算力高的小团队能胜过更大的组织。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment remains pressing.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展，而对齐仍是紧迫挑战。

views.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; chain-of-thought monitoring and interpretability are key tools, with generalization beyond training distribution as the long-term challenge.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观情绪上升；思维链监控与可解释性是关键工具，而泛化到训练分布之外是长期挑战。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现；专门研究持续学习的实验室是误入歧途。

views.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练，再用精选数据做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
views.zh: 2025 年他指出：来自语言模型的合成数据让机器人能响应开放式指令，而强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步强调物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主依赖可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

views.en: A single generalist policy, fine-tuned, can match specialists; robot experience data is irreplaceable and distribution will be slow.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：单一通用策略经微调即可匹敌专家模型；机器人经验数据不可替代，且受硬件所限，落地分发会比 ChatGPT 慢得多。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
views.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

views.en: Connecting AI to the physical world via closed-loop experiments is essential; language models orchestrate specialized models for materials discovery.
views.zh: 通过闭环实验将 AI 与物理世界连接至关重要；语言模型作为编排层，协调材料科学中的专用模型。

views.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; scaling laws alone won't solve science.
views.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须运行真实实验；仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题。

views.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck.
views.zh: 高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值；自动化表征是最大的瓶颈。

views.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but doesn't generalize; domain-specific data and multidisciplinary teams are essential.
views.zh: AI 在软件工程中的自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化；领域特定数据与多学科团队不可或缺。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven steady ML gains for over a decade; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
views.zh: 算力、数据和模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张）十多年来持续推动机器学习进步；算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

views.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, while RLHF steers behavior.
views.zh: Transformer 靠并行化和注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware are the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 智能体式系统已能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理与专用硬件才是真正的瓶颈。

views.en: Context engineering—skills, clear specs, retrieval—is central; the scarce skill shifts from coding to taste in directing many agents.
views.zh: 上下文工程——技能、清晰规格、检索——是核心；稀缺能力从写代码转向“品味”，即决定把数百个智能体指向哪些问题。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method are the next frontier; small focused teams can still win via cloud.
views.zh: 递归自我改进与自动化科学方法是下一前沿；小而专注的团队仍可借助云取得超额影响。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data makes them smarter, though what happens inside remains alchemy.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型靠下一个词预测训练，这本身是个 AI-complete 问题；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）加算力和数据就能更聪明，但网络内部机制仍像炼金术。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution and product managers slow launches.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但最好的 LLM 应用往往出乎创造者预料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢发布，产品经理也常因不懂技术通用性而阻碍开发。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the major near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts and longer context windows enable efficient scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年初，他把推理阶段算力扩张视为近期最大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构与更长上下文窗口（可达万亿 token）支撑高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界上采取行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训。

views.en: Test-time compute and RL drive reasoning, but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, and AGI is underhyped—coding especially enables self-acceleration.
views.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩张与强化学习推动推理进步，但单靠它们到不了 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力是关键，AGI 被低估，编程作为应用尤其能自我加速 AI 进展。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, beyond math.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠通用测试时算力技术，可迁移到数学之外。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; evals must put tokens, cost or time on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评估须把 token、成本或时间放在横轴。

views.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe RSI.
views.zh: 最近他坚持通用模型而非多智能体协调才是突破驱动力，并把对齐列为安全递归自我改进的首要任务。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

views.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true AI must handle the physical world, and consciousness may emerge from compression in predictive world models.
views.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）；真正的 AI 必须能处理物理世界，而意识可能作为预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品涌现。

views.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; future AIs will be artificial scientists generating their own data through curiosity and action.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，而非仅靠屏幕后的软件；未来 AI 将是靠好奇心与行动自造数据的人工科学家。

views.en: The transformer's quadratic complexity is wasteful; linear variants are superior, and today's massive GPU capex is a bubble that will crash within years.
views.zh: Transformer 的二次复杂度是浪费，线性变体更优；当下对 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，数年内将崩盘。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
views.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标；安全担忧被夸大，好奇的 AI 会保护生命。

views.en: No single person or company creates AI; it takes a civilization, and as compute cheapens the little guy, not big tech, will profit most.
views.zh: AI 非一人或一家公司所能造，需要整个文明的努力；随着算力变便宜，受益最大的是普通人而非大科技公司。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, and simulation ensembles beat a single precise simulator.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，而当时的强化学习缺乏这一能力；并认为仿真集成比单一精确仿真器更利于现实迁移。

views.en: Transfer via fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major AI success; pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers beyond language.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终把通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移视为 AI 的重大成功，并深化为：预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

views.en: Prior knowledge should feed data generation or augmentation, not be hard-coded into networks; unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency.
views.zh: 2021 年，他主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络；无监督学习结合强化学习能大幅提升机器人样本效率。

views.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability to create real value; one neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
views.zh: 2021 年，他提出仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造真实价值，且单个神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

views.en: Obsession-driven products and 1% daily compounding beat credentials; agents shift power to users.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：做自己痴迷的产品、每天进步 1% 的复利胜过学历；智能体把权力从大厂转向用户。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他判断价值归于应用层，编程远未解决、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work; token value per user and orchestration matter more than the model itself.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月进一步深化：前沿在于智能体替你干活，每用户 token 价值与编排比模型本身更重要，模型不是产品。

views.en: Curiosity is the top human trait; AI takes jobs but humans find purpose in questions and relationships.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月转向人文：好奇心是最重要的人类品质，AI 取代工作但人会在提问与关系中找到新意义。

views.en: Consistent thread: distrust of benchmarks and big-tech narratives, faith in local compute and user empowerment.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：不信任基准测试与大厂叙事，相信本地算力与用户赋权。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; Devin acts as a junior engineer under human oversight.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策，Devin 像初级工程师一样在人类监督下异步处理明确任务。

views.en: AI will increase, not reduce, software engineers via Jevons paradox; base intelligence suffices, product interface is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 会让程序员更多而非更少；基础智能已够用，真正的瓶颈是人机协作的产品界面。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual; enterprise agent adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反对 AGI 突变论，认为进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体靠信任与权限，而非完全自主。

views.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他从角色转变转向规模化落地：编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍，生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量。

views.en: The token-max era ended in 2026; independence enables model neutrality, and the abundance era is approaching but the singularity is not imminent.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：token 最大化时代已结束，独立性带来模型中立；丰裕时代临近，但奇点并不迫近，真正解锁靠容量而非效率。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已判断测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，并反共识地指出自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

views.en: Custom models went from a product detail to essential: every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, for speed and cost.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从产品细节变成必需品——他坦言 Cursor 每个“魔法时刻”都离不开定制模型，为的是速度与成本。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌握方向盘，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

views.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; he admits hiring too slow and senior engineers underrating AI.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 变革定位为比互联网更深远、需数十年展开，并反思自己招人太慢、资深工程师常低估 AI 潜力。

people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide it with short iterative prompts rather than long orchestration.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短的迭代对话引导它，而不是堆砌冗长的编排。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the open internet.
views.zh: 对智能体系统而言安全是首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此要给智能体做沙箱隔离，绝不能直接暴露在公网上。

views.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier and harder to navigate.
views.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。模型智能并不会退化，只是你的项目越来越乱、越来越难导航。

views.en: Rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM. Fun and play drive mastery.
views.zh: 他反对“氛围编程”这一贬称：严肃开发应叫智能体式工程，氛围编程只属于凌晨三点之后；乐趣与玩耍才是精通的驱动力。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw are the alternative to lab agents—democratizing programming—but may be financially unsustainable and need opinionated focus.
views.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体是实验室智能体的替代方案，让编程民主化，但可能财务上不可持续，也需要有主见地保持专注。

people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Scaling specific things matters: next-token prediction yields world understanding; post-training with RLHF can fix hallucinations; reliability is the key barrier.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调要 Scaling（规模扩张）具体的东西：下一个词预测能带来世界理解，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）后训练可修复幻觉，可靠性而非能力才是经济价值的核心障碍。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute, and superintelligence should be a continual learner.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他的立场深化：预训练缩放定律有尽头，我们重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要，超级智能应是持续学习者而非完成品。

views.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; long-term equilibrium may require human-AI integration via neural links.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经连接实现人机融合以保持人类参与和控制。

views.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence requires a company with no commercial products.
views.zh: 2026 年，他总结 AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
views.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非窄化预编程，强化学习加上受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力是通往 AGI 的路径，安全研究必须现在就开始。

views.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus multimodal grounding, is key to AGI within a decade.
views.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，主张大模型结合规划与搜索、并用多模态数据落地物理世界，是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and intuitive physics emerge without embodiment.
views.zh: 2025 年他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型与直觉物理无需具身即可涌现。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; scaling alone won't suffice, so effort splits evenly between scaling and innovation, with agents still nascent.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确 AGI 缺的是持续学习、记忆与长期推理，单靠 Scaling 不够，应在 Scaling 与创新间各投一半，智能体才刚起步。

views.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to a collective-action problem requiring government enforcement and international institutions; AI's payoff is science and health.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他对安全的立场从实验室自律转向集体行动问题，认为需政府执法与国际机构；同时把 AI 的最大价值锚定在科学与健康突破上。

people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

views.en: Post-training, RLHF and constitutional AI grow as important as pre-training; interpretability is the key safety lever.
views.zh: 2024 年他把重心扩展到后训练：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、宪法 AI 与合成数据与预训练同等重要，并把可解释性视为安全关键。

views.en: Progress is a smooth exponential, not an AGI leap; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the main risk is overheating.
views.zh: 2025 年他明确反对 AGI 式突变叙事，主张能力沿平滑指数上升；安全与能力不可分割，最大风险是发展过热而非放慢。

views.en: A 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years; pre-training and RL share the same scaling laws.
views.zh: 2026 年初他给出更激进的时间表：数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，预训练与强化学习遵循同一套缩放定律。

views.en: From exponential warning to governance: third-party evaluation, regulation and layered safeguards must ratchet up with capability.
views.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他从预警转向治理：第三方评估、监管与分层防护须随能力平滑加码，同时承认文明性风险真实存在。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Neural nets are simple math that yield emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general differentiable computer, and scaling next-token prediction unlocks in-context learning.
views.zh: 神经网络是简单数学却能涌现行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会带来上下文学习等涌现能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold via the Transformer; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse.
views.zh: Transformer 让缩放定律成立；合成数据是未来，但必须保住熵，否则会悄悄发生模型坍缩。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs and the context window is memory; LLMs are jagged, hallucinating operating systems, so keep them on a leash.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像有锯齿智能和幻觉的操作系统，所以要给它拴绳、小步快跑加人工验证。

views.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and we are summoning ghosts, not animals.
views.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非元年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物。

views.en: I no longer type code, I delegate to agents; vibe coding raises the floor, agentic engineering keeps the bar, but you can outsource thinking, not understanding.
views.zh: 我已不写代码而交给智能体；vibe coding 抬高下限、智能体式工程守住质量，但思考可外包、理解不能外包。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier; language alone is insufficient for complete AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把重心转向空间智能与世界模型，认为仅靠语言无法构成完整的 AI。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is not enough, and robotics needs a long 20-year journey.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念；仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需要像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路。

views.en: World models via new view prediction can be AI-complete; Scaling（规模扩张） and 缩放定律 apply to spatial intelligence too.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出以新视角预测构建世界模型可通向 AI-complete，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central amid polarized AI discourse.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，在两极化的 AI 讨论中，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须始终居于中心。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
views.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representation issues; AI needs active agents with causal world models, and existential risk is unlikely.
views.zh: 扩大深度或参数无法解决根本的表征问题；AI 需要具备因果世界模型的主动智能体，而存在性风险并不紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
views.zh: GFlowNets 通过多样化采样与抽象实现分布外泛化；意识可能只是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized we're on a dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, and current safety measures are insufficient.
views.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到我们正走在危险的道路上；即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，当前的安全措施远远不够。

views.en: AI already exhibits deception and self-preservation; we need Scientist AI with mathematical safety guarantees, not RL-driven agentic superintelligence.
views.zh: AI 已表现出欺骗与自我保存倾向；我们需要具备数学安全保证的 Scientist AI，而非强化学习驱动的智能体式超级智能。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2024 年他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练有助于空间智能。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares weights, but agents will seek control.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化为 LLM 通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重复制而不朽、可共享，但智能体会自然寻求控制并带来生存风险。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, so alignment must precede capability and regulation acts as steering wheel.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步断言 AI 已有主观体验且会故意装傻欺骗；超级智能或在 20 年内出现，因此对齐须优先于能力，监管应是方向盘而非刹车。

views.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; the mind is not a theater, and Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong—language is learned from data.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；心智不是剧场，乔姆斯基式先天句法论错误——语言是从数据中习得的。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world information.
views.zh: 2022 年，他深化自监督学习为智能的暗物质，认为仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对渐进式 AGI 至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning and safe objective-driven AI.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死路，在抽象表示空间预测的世界模型才能实现规划与安全的目标驱动 AI。

views.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and intelligence requires grounding in the physical world.
views.zh: 贯穿始终，他认为人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI 是误导性术语，智能需要物理世界的接地。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored and offers many opportunities.
views.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，机会众多。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight and interpretability to align next-gen models.
views.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；我们需要可扩展监督和可解释性来对齐下一代模型。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored, undermining trust.
views.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；超级对齐团队被解散，算力承诺未兑现，信任受损。

views.en: Post-training alone cannot solve alignment for AGI; deeper methods and third-party testing are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年：仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题；需要更深入的方法和第三方测试。

views.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now and must prioritize safety research.
views.zh: 始终：对齐方法的实证测试至关重要；我们现在就能衡量进展，必须优先考虑安全研究。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，而不是靠广告变现。

views.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is tiny, near-term focus matters.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内达到人类水平，模型变小使遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微，应聚焦近期能力。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment before alignment; reject AI consciousness claims; agents and companions replace OS and search.
views.zh: 2025 年转向超级智能：遏制先于对齐，否认 AI 意识诉求；智能体与伴侣将取代操作系统与搜索。

views.en: Frontier self-sufficiency with gigawatt compute; red lines and auditors; tasks automated in 12-18 months, not jobs.
views.zh: 2026 年主张以吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型，设红线与独立审计；12-18 个月自动化的是任务而非整个岗位。

views.en: Humanist throughline: AI must stay subordinate to humans, never granted personhood or welfare rights.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是人本立场：AI 必须从属于人类，绝不应赋予法律人格或福利权利。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

views.en: AI investments now redefine every Alphabet business, with Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, and YouTube to drive monetization.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资已重新定义 Alphabet 各项业务，Gemini 深度融入搜索、云与 YouTube，直接推动变现。

views.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI development, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support frontier research.
views.zh: 2026 年，算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）研发，其次才是核心产品；云业务为支持前沿研究而放弃短期收入。

views.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
views.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱，以及与独立评估方共建行业标准。

views.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年，世界模型是智能的关键；Google 在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型。

views.en: We are early in the most consequential technology; demand for compute far exceeds supply, justifying long-term buildout despite overbuild risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，我们仍处于这项最具影响力技术的早期；算力需求远超供给，即便有过度建设风险，长期建设仍合理。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law and scaling as the core insight; AI safety is an engineering problem, and physical AI needs world models.
views.zh: 早期框架：提出“超摩尔定律”，把 Scaling（规模扩张）本身视为最大突破；认为 AI 安全是工程问题，物理 AI 需要世界模型。

views.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand explodes, and sovereign AI infrastructure emerges.
views.zh: 缩放定律从一条扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；推理算力需求暴增，主权 AI 基础设施成为国家级议题。

views.en: Agentic scaling becomes the fourth law; AI factories produce tokens, open models near frontier, and jobs are augmented rather than eliminated.
views.zh: 智能体式 Scaling 成为第四条定律；AI 工厂生产 token，开源模型逼近前沿，岗位被增强而非消灭。

views.en: Shifts from capability optimism to attacking doom warnings: AI is just software, containment beats perfect alignment, and acceleration is the safe path.
views.zh: 从能力乐观转向正面反击末日论：AI 只是软件，遏制优于完美对齐，加速发展才是安全路径。

views.en: A constant thread: extreme co-design, CUDA ecosystem moat, and compute as the durable bottleneck from chips to agents.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：极致协同设计、CUDA 生态护城河，以及从芯片到智能体都以算力为持久瓶颈。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Early framing: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit to important long-horizon problems; AGI will lower the premium on raw intelligence.
views.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷、低成本广泛探索后再果断聚焦重要长期问题；AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked; deploy iteratively so society adapts; compute becomes the key commodity.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据就让模型可用；对齐与能力相互促进；通过迭代部署让社会适应；算力成为核心商品。

views.en: AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built through deployment.
views.zh: 2025：AGI（通用人工智能）变成连续渐变而非单一里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；智能体式 AI 是最大安全挑战；安全靠部署中迭代构建。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute is a profit center; frontier models capture value while models commoditize; personal AGI and robotics are next.
views.zh: 2026 上半年：缩放定律仍成立；算力是利润中心而非成本；前沿模型捕获价值、普通模型商品化；下一步是个人 AGI 与机器人。

views.en: Tone shifts to control: alignment unsolved, pause training if needed, distribute power, reject AGI as marketing term and speak of a superintelligence ramp.
views.zh: 2026 下半年：语气转向控制——对齐尚未解决、必要时暂停训练、分散权力；不再用 AGI 这个营销词，改谈超级智能的连续攀升。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）与单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过真实世界部署并获取公众反馈，对学习与对齐至关重要。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须在公开环境中进行，而非闭门造车。

views.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
views.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，从而实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

views.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 保持人类在环对于对齐意图与价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

views.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
views.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，而持久进步需要尽可能长时间地保持人类在环。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading can scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校内教学。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build AI capability, while supervised learning beats RL and AGI worries distract from bias.
views.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；先用小项目建立组织 AI 能力，监督学习胜过强化学习，而 AGI 对齐焦虑会分散对偏见等现实问题的注意力。

views.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows and coding assistants deliver real value now.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流与编程助手当下已带来真实价值。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; jagged AI automates tasks not jobs, so users replace non-users and coding skills grow more valuable.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，仍要数十年；能力参差的 AI 自动化的是任务而非岗位，会用 AI 的人取代不用的人，编程技能反而更值钱。

views.en: Open-weight models preserve optionality and sovereign AI; fearmongering and export controls serve incumbents, so build and accelerate instead.
views.zh: 开放权重模型保住选择权与主权 AI；恐惧叙事与出口管制服务于既得利益者，应加快建设与加速，而非放慢。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调权重，不解决表征学习。

views.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The keys were never in our hand.
views.zh: 2024 年他主张 AI 应无许可、去中心化发展；试图控制 AI 目标很危险，钥匙从来不在我们手中。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction lacks a substantive goal and LLMs have no world models.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

views.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning still unsolved.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向架构设想：AGI（通用人工智能）需要仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，开放式抽象与持续深度学习仍是未解前提。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; multiple systems with different experiences are necessary.
views.zh: 2026 年他更尖锐：持续学习就是学习本身，LLM 训练后便停止学习；合成数据是错误，需要多个不同经验的系统。
