people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Scaling simple algorithms with massive compute can exceed human performance; engineering and iterative training matter more than new ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年，他主张用海量算力扩展简单算法即可超越人类表现，工程与迭代训练比发明新的机器学习科学更重要。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought and alignment from human preferences are needed.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI 因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链和从人类偏好中学习对齐。

views.en: Compute becomes the fundamental bottleneck; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models, and AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他转向强调算力是根本瓶颈，后训练结合强化学习精炼基座模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated with no wall in sight; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and compute supply—not architecture or data—is the real constraint.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律未见天花板，预训练提升会放大下游收益，真正的约束是算力供给而非架构或数据。

views.en: Safety and security become first-class, co-designed with capability; iterative deployment and scalable oversight let proactive agents earn trust as AGI arrives.
views.zh: 2026 年，他将安全与安保提升为一等要求，与能力协同设计；通过迭代部署和可扩展监督，让主动式智能体在 AGI 到来时赢得信任。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 才是关键，而非一味做大模型；开源能通过广泛审视促进安全。

views.en: Efficiency and data quality are equal to compute; value accrues at application layer; open source drives enterprise distribution.
views.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调效率与数据质量和算力同等重要；价值将沉淀在应用层；开源推动企业级分发。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open source empowers enterprises; jobs are augmented, not replaced, requiring human-in-the-loop.
views.zh: 2025 年他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权可控；开源赋能企业；工作被增强而非替代，需要人类在环。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; AGI as one system won't exist; pre-training saturates, gains come from vertical fine-tuning and agentic platforms.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为模型正在商品化；单一系统的 AGI 不会存在；预训练触及饱和，增益来自垂直微调和智能体平台。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for AI infrastructure autonomy; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change; AGI is a direction, not destination.
views.zh: 2026 年他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建设自主 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革；AGI 是方向而非终点。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering method; production at scale, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 2021 年，他把第一性原理和完全可复用视为工程核心方法，并强调真正的瓶颈是规模化生产而非原型。

views.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking: programming AI to lie, even for good ends, is the biggest risk, more than superintelligence itself.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观转向求真：即便出于善意让 AI 说谎也是最大风险，其危险甚于超级智能本身。

views.en: Civilization risk expands from AI to population collapse, open borders and government waste; AI and robots become the only fix.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，文明风险从 AI 扩展到人口崩塌、开放边境与政府浪费，AI 和机器人成为唯一解。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI compute and inference to space; orbital data centers and solar become the scaling path.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，AI 算力与推理被推向太空，轨道数据中心和太阳能成为扩张路径。

views.en: Superintelligence arrives within years; humans won't control it, so safety rests on truth, curiosity and peer review among labs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能数年内到来、人类将无法控制，安全只能靠求真、好奇心与实验室间同行评审。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; recent gains come mainly from post-training RL, synthetic data, and reasoning models' chain of thought.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调预训练缩放定律依然成立，但近期收益主要来自后训练：强化学习、合成数据，以及推理模型用思维链和强化学习提升正确率。

views.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong: progress is a smooth exponential, though frontier models still fail at tasks a 5-year-old can do.
views.zh: 2025 年他反驳“AI 放缓”叙事：进展是平滑的指数曲线，只是前沿模型仍会在五岁小孩能做的简单任务上失败，因此常被误读。

views.en: Economic pressure and distillation, not technical limits, shifted focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper deployed models.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他认为让预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）放缓的是经济压力与蒸馏，而非技术极限，焦点转向更小更便宜的部署模型。

views.en: Reasoning plus RL and tools solves hard problems but stays jagged; generalization still needs vast data, unlike human few-shot learning.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：推理配合强化学习与工具能解难题，却仍呈“锯齿状”；泛化依旧依赖海量数据，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex give 5-10x parallel productivity; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年他看好 Codex 这类智能体带来 5-10 倍并行生产力，并把系统被黑等近期风险置于存在性风险之上，同时认为开源模型会因主权需求持续存在。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
views.zh: 2014 年从经典机器学习出发，把学习算法拆成假设类、损失函数与优化方法，并强调训练/验证/测试划分以防过拟合。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
views.zh: 2024 年转向大模型：认为下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，架构已非关键，AGI 或在 4-50 年内到来。

views.en: Safety is not automatic with scale: jailbreaks are a fundamental flaw, and open weights need limits at high capability.
views.zh: 2024 到 2026 年主线延续：安全不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动到来，越狱是根本性缺陷，高能力时开放权重需受限。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layered defenses; agents bring prompt injection; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
views.zh: 2026 年深化：安全需显式训练与多层防御，智能体带来提示注入新风险，可解释性或借 AI 智能体自动化研究而成功。

views.en: Automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not equal robustness; the lethal trifecta defines prompt injection risk.
views.zh: 2026 年更近：自动红队可胜过人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关，提示注入的“致命三要素”界定风险，企业级 AI 安全需求上升。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题、显著提升模型智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

views.en: RL on language models is a new scaling axis with no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把语言模型上的强化学习视为没有上限的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
views.zh: 2025 年他反复强调，智能体的进展取决于随时间推移的可靠性而非原始能力，而编程是 AI 进步最领先的指标。

views.en: Interpretability and alignment faking raise safety concerns; alignment research is more promising than AI 2027 assumes.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他借可解释性与“对齐伪装”提出安全担忧，并认为对齐研究比 AI 2027 的假设更有希望。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute now matter most; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为能力过剩使编排与算力成为关键，世界模型不在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上，编程与 AI 研究才是直路。

people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are practical but fragile: safety is a system-level property, and fine-tuning can undo alignment with little compute.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调虽实用却脆弱：安全是系统级属性，微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐。

views.en: Post-training becomes the main lever: data quality beats algorithms, with SFT, DPO and RLVR stages; open recipes can match frontier models.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量胜过算法，分为 SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 阶段；开放配方足以比肩前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make scaling RL harder than RLHF.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，但过度优化与系统问题让扩展强化学习比 RLHF 更难。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断缩放定律在预训练中仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完；增益转向后训练与推理扩展。

views.en: Open models become the engine of research and sovereign AI, trailing closed frontier by 6-9 months; compute constraints widen the US-China gap.
views.zh: 2026 年，他视开放模型为研究与主权 AI 的引擎，落后闭源前沿 6 到 9 个月；算力约束将拉大中美差距。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

From Squiggle to Scale: Alex's Founder Journey
Alexander Wang on Data as the New Code and the Future of AI
Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not infinite compute, is the key bottleneck for machine learning.
views.zh: 2019 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，机器学习的关键瓶颈是数据而非无限算力，Scale 做的是数据精炼基础设施。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limit on Scaling（规模扩张）is data and expert post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非「新石油」，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专有数据做后训练才是提升前沿模型的关键，而智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体构成超越预训练和强化学习的新范式。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; safety, scalable oversight and selective open-sourcing now temper his earlier open-source enthusiasm.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他主张超级智能临近，需以对齐、可扩展监督和选择性开源把关——相较早年对开源的推崇明显收紧。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

Claude Code: The Future of AI Agents and Software Engineering

views.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users are highly valued.
views.zh: 潜在需求是产品第一原则：发现用户已有的意图并围绕它构建；能写代码、做设计、与用户交流的通用型工程师极受重视。

views.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's model; scaffolding is temporary tech debt, so don't bet against the model.
views.zh: 为六个月后的模型构建，而不是今天的模型；脚手架是临时技术债，不要与模型对赌。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of my code is written by Claude Code, and the software engineer title will fade into 'builder'.
views.zh: 编程已基本解决：我的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，软件工程师头衔将淡出，演变为“构建者”。

views.en: Safety is core, not sci-fi: releasing early in the wild and using coding as a clean domain for alignment research improves model safety.
views.zh: 安全是核心而非科幻：尽早真实发布，并以编程作为对齐研究的清晰领域，能提升模型安全性。

views.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; give models tools and let them self-verify, with less instruction and more empirical iteration.
views.zh: 智能体之后的下一抽象层是循环；给模型工具让其自我验证，减少指令、更多实证迭代。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily; product taste is the most valuable skill as code becomes cheaper.
views.zh: 2026 年，产品经理必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，每周甚至每天发布功能；随着代码成本降低，产品品味成为最有价值的技能。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Code and Claude Tag are used internally to build themselves.
views.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体让工程师将实现工作委托出去，专注于产品品味和商业判断；Claude Code 和 Claude Tag 在内部用于构建自身。

views.en: System prompts shrank 80% for frontier models by removing examples and hard constraints, relying on model judgment; giving examples can hurt creativity.
views.zh: 2026 年，前沿模型的系统提示词通过移除示例和硬性约束缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型判断；提供示例可能损害创造力。

views.en: Auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer for prompt injection and data exfiltration risks; humans should be removed from code review for outer-layer changes.
views.zh: 2026 年，在提示注入和数据外泄风险上，自动模式比普通人类审查者更安全；对于外层变更，应将人类从代码审查循环中移除。

views.en: Rewrites are now good; a codebase is a spec, and with a good test suite rewriting is fine; tool design is more biology than physics.
views.zh: 2026 年，重写代码现在可行；代码库就是规格说明，有了好的测试套件重写没问题；工具设计更像生物学而非物理学。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Claude Code: Mods, Mutable Software, and Multiplayer Agents — Thariq Shihipar, Anthropic
Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架允许的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning shifts from a static spec to iterative human-agent dialogue; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
views.zh: 规划从一次性静态文档转向持续的人机对话；更精简、原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则。

views.en: Agents need loops, goals and workflows to run autonomously; separate verification agents counter self-referential bias.
views.zh: 智能体需要循环、目标与工作流才能长时间自主运行；独立的验证智能体可抵消自我指涉偏差。

views.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude, spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity.
views.zh: 提示词是元技能：建立对 Claude 的心智模型，前置投入上下文与算力，让投入随任务复杂度伸缩。

views.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must own.
views.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；前沿节奏是工程师必须理解并倡导的技术问题。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code

views.en: Early 2026: Dogfooding builds empathy and product pulse; leaders should stay hands-on and use one-on-ones for live conversations, not status updates.
views.zh: 2026 年初：吃自己的狗粮能培养共情和产品脉搏；领导者应保持动手，一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新。

views.en: May 2026: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs, and AI assists code reviews.
views.zh: 2026 年 5 月：工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和协调才是。规划变得即时，设计文档让位于 PR，AI 辅助代码评审。

views.en: June 2026: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption are key; verification and quality frameworks matter more.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈，它提升了每个人的上限。高能动性与高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 是关键；验证和质量框架更重要。

views.en: Across 2026: Managers should start as ICs to dogfood the product and build street cred; flat orgs, kill outdated processes, and focus on outcomes over output.
views.zh: 贯穿 2026 年：管理者应从个人贡献者做起，吃自己的狗粮并建立信誉；扁平化组织，淘汰过时流程，关注结果而非产出。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到大型语言模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，需要算法创新。

views.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but can confuse models.
views.zh: 推理时计算是新的扩展轴；搜索和代码执行等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆但可能使模型困惑。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential, especially with clean reward signals.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级增长的算力；后训练强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲，尤其需要干净的奖励信号。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities for scaling.
views.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决；持续学习和元学习是 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键缺失能力。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
views.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究实验室；缩放定律未死，预训练是需重建的肌肉，探索比最终训练消耗更多算力。

views.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
views.zh: 过去一年最大更新是科研自动化：模型产出新知识，并定下 1 年内出 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

views.en: As models grow more capable, alignment challenges like model scheming become key in the next 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers remain critical.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者始终重要。

views.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in AI for math; automation level tracks verification stringency, so education must shift to project-based assessment and teach verification skills.
views.zh: 在数学领域，验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此教育须转向项目式评估并教授验证技能。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis as benchmarks saturate.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学与编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；基准饱和令评估陷入危机。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data diversity are the key to physical AI generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作当年 Transformer 时刻的重演：硬件已就绪、软件在追赶，开源与数据多样性是物理 AI 泛化的关键。

views.en: World models and video generation can synthesize training data, easing robotics' data bottleneck.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他持续强调世界模型与视频生成能合成训练数据，缓解机器人数据瓶颈。

views.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxing, is the decisive security layer.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全正交，真正的决定性安全层是对齐，而非沙箱与护栏。

views.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; a deliberate slowdown needs open science.
views.zh: 2026 年他警告：缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，而有意放缓需要开放科学与国际合作。

views.en: Open source wins long term on cost and control, and openness need not mean accelerationism.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源凭成本与控制力终将胜出，且支持开放并不等于支持加速主义。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Beam: Building America's Open Frontier Model with Reflection AI's Misha Laskin
Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

views.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是超级智能完备的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

views.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，而非全面提升；苦涩教训的核心是用算力和搜索做 Scaling，而非泛化。

views.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and SWE-bench misaligns with real engineering.
views.zh: 2025 年，他批评 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；并认为 SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表智能体有用。

views.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; openness, like encryption, aids defenders and broad access.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性提升为核心立场：开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态，如同加密技术，开放既利于防御者也利于广泛获取。

views.en: RL on strong pre-training yields efficient agents; compute efficiency still improves fast, and open-model token demand will surpass closed.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张在强预训练之上做强化学习才能得到高效智能体；算力效率仍在快速提升，开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，企业会以定制系统而非仅微调来采用开放模型。

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI accelerates scientists rather than replacing them.
views.zh: AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 让科学家更快工作，而不是取代他们。

views.en: Confidence metrics are central to trust: useful science AI needs reliable uncertainty, not perfect interpretability.
views.zh: 置信度指标是信任的核心：有用的科学 AI 需要可靠的不确定性度量，而非完美的可解释性。

views.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins beat pure Scaling.
views.zh: AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构与许多中等规模胜利胜过单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it gives prediction and control, understanding stays with humans.
views.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对单一实验的窄域预测器，不是整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

views.en: Grand challenges yield practical tools; AI narrows hypothesis space, and new curated datasets are the next bottleneck in biology.
views.zh: 宏大挑战催生实用工具；AI 收窄假设空间，而新的策展数据集是生物学下一个瓶颈。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms matter more; scaling alone won't yield common sense.
views.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练提供广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与推理阶段算法更关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法带来常识。

views.en: Consistent thread: data is the real bottleneck, and smaller models with better data and algorithms can rival larger ones.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年一以贯之的主线：数据才是真正的瓶颈，数据与算法更好的小模型可以匹敌大模型。

views.en: By 2025 she frames current AI as interpolating human knowledge, not transcending it; abductive reasoning and exploring unknown knowledge become central.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，她把当前 AI 定位为对人类知识的插值而非超越；溯因推理与探索未知知识成为核心议题。

views.en: Reinforcement learning deepens from post-training tool to a pre-training objective rewarding information gain, though computationally costly.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习从后训练工具深化为奖励信息增益的预训练目标，尽管算力代价高昂。

views.en: Alignment shifts toward pluralistic alignment; debiasing the internet is impossible, so diverse synthetic data and small models democratize AI.
views.zh: 2026 年对齐转向多元对齐：净化互联网不可行，因此多样化的合成数据与小模型成为 AI 民主化的路径。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜一样扩展人类能力的工具，并认为把一切输入 token 化为序列的通用智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

views.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without costly reinforcement learning; innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练智能体；并强调创新可以来自任何地方，大模型并非一切。

views.en: A consistent thread: AI should augment scientists and laborers to solve energy, climate and economic problems, not replace them.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：AI 应增强科学家与劳动者以解决能源、气候和经济问题，而非取代他们。

views.en: By 2026 his focus shifts to AI safety and responsible deployment as today's biggest challenge, with safety still an open problem.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，视其为当今最大挑战，并坦言安全仍是未解难题。

views.en: He reframes Africa as leapfrogging, not behind: local-language models can transform education, and belief is the main barrier.
views.zh: 2026 年他重新定义非洲为“跨越式发展”而非落后：本地语言模型可变革教育，而最大障碍是研究者是否相信自己。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and model disagreement as intrinsic reward improve sample efficiency and robot learning.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调超越训练分布的泛化能力是关键，提出无目标的好奇心驱动探索和以模型分歧作为内在奖励，以提升样本效率和机器人学习。

views.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; robot learning must handle dynamic tasks and sim-to-real without hidden engineering.
views.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，机器人学习必须处理动态任务，且 sim-to-real 不能依赖隐藏工程。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources. A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT can power any robot.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网，必须利用所有数据源；像 ChatGPT 一样的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人。

views.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：部署是首要技术挑战而非商业问题；在多样数据上预训练、在真实世界数据上后训练是关键配方。

views.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot achieve overnight success; video data alone is insufficient, need simulation and real-world data.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地强调机器人不像语言模型能一夜成功；仅视频数据不够，需要仿真和真实世界数据。
